watches.name: Gamma
watches.description: The Octanis Gamma Multi-Calendar Series Architecture Meets Celestial Horology. The Octanis Gamma brings a bold cosmic aesthetic to functional mechanical horology . Blending multi-calendar functionality with soft, celestial pastel hues, the Gamma is engineered for those who demand mechanical substance wrapped in an unforgettable profile . Illuminate your wrist with the celestial mechanics of deep space, the Octanis Gamma draws direct inspiration from its astronomical namesake: the ternary star system situated in the southern constellation of Octans. Just as Gamma Octans relies on three gravitationally bound stars orbiting in precise, harmonious balance, the Gamma model’s architectural dial features a trio of sub-dials positioned at 3, 6, and 9 o'clock to track the day, month, and 24-hour cycle. Through an innovative sandwich dial construction, the colored top layer is carefully cut away at these sub-dials to expose a fully luminous base beneath. In low light, these sub-dials burst into a radiant, self-contained glow—mirroring the vivid tri-star cluster burning brightly against the dark expanse of the night sky, bridging outer space orientation with fine mechanical horology. Powered by the high-beat Miyota Caliber 9120 automatic movement , the Gamma delivers complete timekeeping mastery . Featuring a 3-6-9 sub-dial layout—indicating the Day of the Week , Month , and a 24-Hour scale —alongside a color-matched date window, every function is seamlessly integrated into a balanced, architectural display . Key Architectural Highlights: The Sandwich Dial Depth: A dual-layer dial featuring a matte pastel top layer precision-cut with baton indices, revealing a full-lume BGW9 Super-LumiNova bottom layer that glows with intense, long-lasting blue light after dusk . 5-Link Steel Engineering: Crafted from solid 316L stainless steel with alternating brushed and polished facets . Paired with a milled clasp featuring on-the-fly quick adjustment and quick-release spring bars . Dual-Strap Versatility: Every Gamma ships with both the solid stainless steel 5-link bracelet and a custom-fitted, high-grade sailcloth strap featuring a branded deployant clasp and quick-release spring bars . Double-Domed Sapphire: Protected by a scratch-resistant double-domed sapphire crystal with internal anti-reflective (AR) coating for absolute optical clarity under any lighting condition . Two Case Sizes (40mm & 42mm): Engineered in both classic 40mm and bold 42mm proportions to deliver perfect wrist ergonomics for every collector . Engraved Rehaut & Exhibition Back: Features an inner steel rehaut engraved with the Octanis name, framed by a sapphire exhibition caseback showcasing the high-beat mechanical movement within . Technical Specifications: Movement: Miyota 9120 Automatic (High-Beat 28,800 vph / 4 Hz) Functions: Hours, Minutes, Sweeping Seconds, Day (9 o'clock), Month (3 o'clock), 24-Hour Indicator (6 o'clock), Date (4:30) Case Material: 316L Stainless Steel (Brushed and Polished) Case Diameter: 40mm or 42mm Crystal: Double-domed Sapphire with Internal AR Coating Dial: Sandwich Construction (Matte Pastel Top / Full BGW9 Lume Bottom) Lume: Swiss BGW9 Super-LumiNova (Dial & Hands) Water Resistance: 10 ATM / 100 Meters (Screw-down / Push-pull crown with embossed Octanis Star) Straps Included: 5-Link Stainless Steel Bracelet + Custom Sailcloth Strap w/ Deployant Clasp (Both Quick-Release) Limitation: Strictly limited run per colorway . Celestial Colorways: Supernova Blue Nebula Pink Starlight Violet

watches.name: Octanis Sigma GMT 42 - Founders Edition - Astronomical Twilight
watches.description: The Edge of the Void: Modern Navigation Meets Horological Precision. Named after the south polar star, the Sigma GMT is purpose-built for those who chart their own course across land, sea, and sky. Astronomical Twilight: Navigating the Dark In the final phase of twilight before total nocturnal pitch, the sun dips 18 degrees below the horizon. The atmosphere glows in a deep, electric blue while the vastness of space reveals its first celestial beacons. The Astronomical Twilight edition captures this exact transition: a crisp white dial bounded by a deep blue internal 24-hour rehaut. It’s high-contrast, ultra-legible, and framed in architectural 316L stainless steel. An homage to early maritime octants used by voyagers who trusted only the stars to guide them home. True Flyer GMT Power: The Miyota 9075 When crossing time zones, true navigators don't stop their engines. Powered by the Japanese Miyota 9075 automatic caliber, the Sigma is a genuine Flyer GMT . Unlike entry-level "office" GMTs, pulling the crown allows you to jump the local hour hand in precise one-hour increments without stopping the balance wheel or disrupting your home time . High-Beat Smoothness: 28,800 vph (4Hz) sweep for effortless precision. Exhibition Sapphire Caseback: Sapphire crystal on both front and back reveals the decorated rotor and mechanical beating heart underneath. Dual-Crown Internal Rehaut: 3 Time Zones on Command External bezel inserts chip, fade, and snag. The Sigma features an internal rotating 24-hour rehaut operating via a secondary knurled crown at the 2H position. Protected under flat sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating, this internal bezel allows you to track a third time zone on demand while keeping the case sleek, protected, and rated for 100 meters (10 ATM) of water resistance. Hand-Inspected & Hand-Regulated Before GPS, navigators relied on the octant: an instrument that demanded absolute precision because lives depended on it. We build Octanis in that exact spirit. Every piece in this 120-unit Founder’s Edition run is personally inspected and hand-regulated before leaving our workbench. What’s Included in Your Voyage Package: 3-Watch Travel Roll: Premium canvas and leather storage for life on the move. Bonus FKM Rubber Strap: Color-matched in deep astronomical blue for water and sports wear. Quick-Adjust Bracelet: On-the-fly micro-adjustment buckle for instant sizing shifts as your wrist changes throughout the day. Commemorative Warranty Card & Octanis Seal. watches.name: Octanis Sigma GMT 42 - Founders Edition - Civil Twilight
watches.description: The First Light of Discovery: High-Visibility Precision for the Modern Explorer. Named after the south polar star, the Sigma GMT blends land, air, and sea navigation into an unmistakable architectural tool. Civil Twilight: Golden Hour Meets High Contrast Civil Twilight begins as the sun sits just 0 to 6 degrees below the horizon. The golden window when sunlight illuminates terrestrial landscapes while terrestrial lights begin to flicker on. It is the moment of peak visibility, where clear optics and immediate legibility matter most. The Civil Twilight edition pays homage to this transition with a rich, forest-green dial accented by a stark white internal 24-hour rehaut. Designed with a clean, tactical-meets-refined palette, it brings bold color to everyday wrist presence without compromising technical utility. True Flyer GMT Power: The Miyota 9075 When your journey takes you across time zones, the Sigma adapts on the fly. Powered by the Japanese Miyota 9075 automatic caliber, this is a genuine Flyer GMT . Pulling the crown allows you to independently jump the main hour hand in one-hour steps without stopping the seconds hand or disturbing your reference time . High-Beat Smoothness: 28,800 vph (4Hz) sweep for smooth, continuous precision. Exhibition Sapphire Caseback: Display back lets you inspect the automatic winding weight and balance assembly at work. Dual-Crown Internal Rehaut: 3 Time Zones on Command Protected beneath scratch-resistant sapphire crystal, the internal rotating 24-hour rehaut is controlled via a dedicated secondary crown at the 2H position. Free from the wear and snagging of outer bezels, this dual-crown setup provides instantaneous third-time-zone calculation while maintaining 100 meters (10 ATM) of water resistance. Hand-Inspected & Hand-Regulated In the tradition of classic octants, precision isn't optional. Every single piece in this 120-unit Founder’s Edition run is hand-inspected and regulated on-site before leaving our workshop.
